verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly is an API-driven SaaS platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack contains no documentation of a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. API access tokens, the CLI and the MCP server are adjacent features, not a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
